title: Traditional Ukrainian Borscht
description: A hearty and flavorful beet-based soup originating from Ukraine. This recipe combines the rich flavors of beef, vegetables, and a touch of zesty sour cream.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the carrots and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cabbage and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, beets, borscht, salt, and pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sour cream and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh dill, if desired.
